suppress.notes: CVE-2007-1652 is a defect in the historical OpenID enabled-site/token implementation. AppAuth is a modern native OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect client; this PURL is not the affected OpenID relying-party implementation. This rule is limited to the exact AppAuth PURL and historical CVE.

CVE-2008-0986 targets the BMP parser in obsolete libsgl.so shipped in early Android SDK preview releases, not the modern Google Play Services measurement SDK. This product-identity mismatch is limited to these two exact measurement artifact names.

CVE-2008-3891 applies to the Google Apps SAML Single Sign-On service. The matched artifact is Google Play Services App Set ID SDK, a different product and attack surface. Suppressed only for this exact PURL/CVE pair.
CVE-2012-2055 is a GitHub Enterprise mass-assignment issue. The detector maps it to Glide disklrucache, gifdecoder and core artifacts via an unrelated GitHub CPE. This is not a Glide vulnerability.

CVE-2026-53914 affects the Kotlin Gradle plugin build-cache metadata deserializer, not Kotlin runtime libraries shipped in the app. The Kotlin Gradle plugin is upgraded to 2.4.21 and separately asserted on the build-logic compile classpath in security.yml. This rule is limited to the runtime stdlib/parcelize PURLs reported by the app runtime scan.
